'''2001 North Carolina State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Oxford, NC on 28 April 2001. It is known from Ivan Kanner's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2195">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-30-nc-states-oxford-nc-4-28-01d2195/ nc-states-oxford-nc-4-28-01], DeckTech (Ivan "ZippyDaJedi" Kanner, 30 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-30-nc-states-oxford-nc-4-28-01d2195/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 28 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Oxford, NC
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 37
* '''Winner:''' [[Adam Weinstein]]<ref name="tr-d2216" />

== Discrepancies ==
